name: Keeper of the Siren Song
source:
You were never supposed to be the Keeper of the Siren Song, but now that you’ve snuck into the Trial and deceived everyone, can you convince one of the mer princes to fall in love with you?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
原本怎麼也輪不到你來守護海妖之歌。可你已經偷偷混進試煉，瞞過了所有人。現在，你能讓其中一位人魚王子愛上你嗎？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
